_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_architecture: src/PARAMS.<architecture> at the binary's commit (sci also wants it in scarab_path's checkout).
_experiment: mlp_oracle replay runs (the binary’s default marking on golden_small); they read mlp_oracle_check_spec2026_m47_ref/track's records, so run them after it completes. Generated by tools/mlp_oracle/make_descriptors.py; run with tools/mlp_oracle/run_study.sh.
_workload_manager: manual: run the simulations on this machine, at most max_parallel at a time.
_max_parallel: run_study.sh sets this at launch from idle cores, free memory and your other runs.
_container_reuse: One reused container per slot instead of one per sim.
_root_dir: Output goes to <root_dir>/simulations/<experiment>. The reference and the replay runs must share it.
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: A private clone, so sci's in-place hash checkout cannot disturb a working checkout.
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces, resolved as <traces_dir>/<suite>/<subsuite>/<workload>.
_top_simpoint: false: the simpoints are listed by cluster_id in simulations, or every simpoint of a workload. N: each workload's N heaviest simpoints, weights renormalized.
_simulations: spec2026 omnetpp_r's heaviest simpoint. 1M warmup + 10M measured per simpoint.
_configurations: Binary: c4ae7e61 2026-11-14 Merge pull request #47 from matthewpipie/sync-upstream-46. Marking on every config: --mlp_data_bound 3 --mlp_data_bound_min 16 --mlp_lin_data_thresh 0.0 --mlp_instr_mark 2 --mlp_lin_instr_thresh 0.7 --mlp_instr_starve 2 --mlp_instr_starve_min 1 (set by --marking: none). Machine flags on every config: none. No --inst_limit: the run script runs each simpoint's warmup and segment.

replay_check._params: Replays the reference forcing nothing (mode 1). Must equal lru on every simpoint; if not, the reference was recorded with a different binary or flags. It draws the control as ctrl_*_ro do (same --mlp_oracle_reuse_only), so its MLP_RDMISS_* are the reuse distances of the misses the oracle and the control force (report.py --miss-reuse).

oracle_i_ro._params: Oracle, instruction: the reference's marked misses hit, each line's first miss aside.

ctrl_i_ro._params: Control, instruction: as many random non-cold reference misses as oracle_i_ro forces, on as many lines.

oracle_d_ro._params: Oracle, data: the reference's marked misses hit, each line's first miss aside.

ctrl_d_ro._params: Control, data: as many random non-cold reference misses as oracle_d_ro forces, on as many lines.

oracle_b_ro._params: Oracle, both sides: the reference's marked misses hit, each line's first miss aside.

ctrl_b_ro._params: Control, both sides: as many random non-cold reference misses as oracle_b_ro forces, on as many lines.

ceiling_i._params: Ceiling, instruction: every miss to a line the MLC has held before hits. Independent of the marking.

ceiling_d._params: Ceiling, data: every miss to a line the MLC has held before hits. Independent of the marking.

ceiling_b._params: Ceiling, both sides: every miss to a line the MLC has held before hits. Independent of the marking.

_visualize: ./sci --visualize plots IPC per workload against lru; tools/mlp_oracle/report.py gives the bounds.
